name: Cynbit Studio
description: Next-gen career intelligence and portfolio architecture platform designed for engineers, architects, and technical professionals to build dynamic resumes, showcase project artifacts, and match with verified tech roles.
features: AI resume optimization and ATS scoring
Dynamic portfolio site generator with GitHub sync
Direct pipeline to vetted tech employers
target_users: Software engineers, tech students, and hiring managers.

name: Revio
description: Autonomous AI assistant that monitors, analyzes, and drafts context-aware responses to customer reviews across Google Business, Trustpilot, G2, and social media platforms.
features: Multi-platform review aggregation and sentiment analysis
Autonomous, tone-aligned response draft generation with human review safeguards
Negative feedback alert routing and escalation triggers
Customer sentiment analytics dashboard with root-cause clustering
target_users: Hospitality, retail chains, local service businesses, and SaaS companies.

name: TenantEase
description: All-in-one SaaS platform streamlining landlord-tenant communications, lease agreement tracking, automated rent collection, digital maintenance dispatch, and property portfolio analytics.
features: Automated digital lease signing and KYC verification
Payment gateway integration with automated rent reminders via WhatsApp & Email
Smart maintenance ticket routing with photo diagnosis and contractor assignment
Occupancy analytics, yield forecasting, and expense ledger
target_users: Property managers, real estate firms, co-living operators, and independent landlords.
